scope: RT1 likelihood-guided frame-prefix UCT MCTS post-training from the same SFT50000 checkpoint; 500 updates, one training seed; all128 matched H32 evaluation trajectories

search.tree_unit: One generated dynamics frame per tree edge; input observations/actions/text fixed.
search.selection: UCT on visited children; binary ancestral expansion; one new node per simulation, then stochastic full remaining rollout.
search.backup: exp(mean raw model token log probability over complete10frame trajectory), including stored prefix and rollout suffix; update raw sum/count along all ancestors.
search.value_scaling: At selection only, normalize mean raw Q by current global terminal-return min/max; degenerate range neutral0.5; raw stored returns are never rescaled.
search.final_selection: Stable top4 of16 complete simulations by raw cumulative model log probability. Keep duplicates, no extra diversity resampling.
search.budget_note: 16 rollouts give nontrivial depth/adaptive tree decisions; exceeds nominal8path beam budget and must not be described as equal-compute.

reference: Frozen identical initializer; same generator conditioning intervention as actor
mjev: Frozen SoMarkAI/mJev-Qwen3-VL-4B-RLCD 7af7cda55ea36e76bce64e87a02c9faea1919d64, both orders of all6pairs, candidate-list label logits, same native implementation as Bridge pilot

evaluation.primary: mean frames1..32 then mean all128 trajectories
evaluation.cohort: exact IDs in original configs/cohorts/rt1_128.json, start0; re-evaluate baseline on same runtime

seeds_meaning: Seed20261011;5200unique predetermined train windows,8disjoint smoke,128dev. One global schedule split byrank.
stopping: 500globalupdates;650globalbatch cap; globally all-tied batch skips; local ties zero policy advantage and retainKL
cost: Four H20,16 sequential MCTS simulations per training trajectory,4 returned candidates. This is NOT equal compute to prior8path beam variants. Record actor forward calls/token rows, wall time and4GPU-hours.
frozen: codec,T5,judge and reference; update core and original trained adapters at same fixedlr
training_data: Same sealed 5200 training windows, 8 disjoint smoke windows and 128 dev trajectories as completed RT1 reward controls
gradient_sync: 4 physical DDP ranks x2 trajectories per rank, each loss scaled0.5; firstmicro and first9frames of secondmicro no_sync, synchronize only secondmicro lastframe. All8 proposals/rewards precede optimizer step.
evaluation_parallelism: 128 original dev trajectories indexmodulo4;32cases perGPU; collectall128
metric_reward: negative mean per-frame MAE + VGG LPIPS
prompt_policy: Unchanged from completed mJev500, including inherited T/U-vs-C/D wording. No prompt change during reward ablation.
initialization_description: Text-enabled SFT50000, prior RL0; no additional SFT

generator_text_intervention.judge_uses: Original correct instruction in all arms
generator_text_intervention.no_text: Zero mask in cached proposals/actor/reference and pipeline predictions
generator_text_intervention.shuffled: Frozen split-local bijective different-instruction map; no dev donor used in training

memory: Fixed initial context and fixed dynamics anchor, branch-local last6 state/action pairs; same as prior controls
qualification: One specified likelihood-guided MCTS instantiation; no assertion about all MCTS algorithms; no outcome-based tuning or sample selection
